summary: The identity report now finds the users and admins it used to miss, and the menu shows what needs your attention.

new.title: Sign-in methods read per user
new.text: An optional job reads every user's sign-in methods, admins first. Until a user is read, the report says unknown, never 'no MFA'.

new.title: Red markers show what waits for you
new.text: The menu shows a red count where something waits for you or did not complete, such as queued changes, failed jobs or open tamper events. The Overview links each one.

new.title: Policy list shows analysis and monitors
new.text: Each Conditional Access policy now shows the analysis it waits for or had last, and which monitors cover it.

new.title: Quicker cloud values in the rule editor
new.text: Picking the value for AD-synced users now proposes the matching value for cloud users. One click accepts it, and a value you pick yourself is kept.

fixes.title: MFA views list the right users
fixes.text: 'Active without MFA' and 'No MFA, but a company smartphone' never listed anyone. They now list enabled users who are not registered for MFA.

fixes.title: All admins are now recognised
fixes.text: Anyone who can reach a directory role, directly, through a group or through PIM for Groups, now counts as an admin. Admins with a role through a group were missed before.

fixes.title: More accurate inactivity, guest and licence views
fixes.text: Inactivity and guest views count background sign-ins and find every guest. Microsoft 365 E5 and E3 without Teams are now recognised, so those users are no longer listed as missing a licence.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: AD OU views stay empty until you set an OU pattern, monitor names may hold spaces, and row action menus no longer wrap over two lines.
